newsitem.title: USA: Kohl's 4.6 mln share offering underway.
newsitem.headline: Kohl's 4.6 mln share offering underway.

text.p: Kohl's Corp said Friday that a public offering of 4.6 million of its common shares at $63.8125 per share is underway.
Net proceeds of about $241.1 million to the company from the offering will be used for general corporate purposes, including financing the company's continued store growth.
Kohl's operates 172 specialty department stores primarily in the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic states.
Of the shares offered, 3.9 million are being offered by the company and 700,000 by certain selling shareholders.
Underwriters are led by Morgan Stanley Dean Witter; Merrill Lynch & Co.; Montgomery Securities; William Blair & Company; and Robert W. Baird & Co.
After the offering, Kohl's will have 78 million shares outstanding.
